why: MRA shows bilateral terminal ICA, ACA and MCA stenoses with collateral network; matches stem and key.
Axial FLAIR shows bilateral symmetric parasagittal and parieto-occipital cortical-subcortical hyperintensity, consistent with PRES.
Two-panel image appears FLAIR-type, not clearly DWI; no sequence labels; subtle caudate/putamen signal does not confirm the DWI claim.
Stem and caption say coronal T1; image is an axial FLAIR-type slice. Pontine change is visible but sequence and plane contradict the stem.
Sagittal volume-rendered venogram; superior sagittal sinus non-enhancement not clearly shown. Empty delta sign needs axial contrast slices; arrow points to unclear region.
Coronal T2 shows several skull-base and neck paraganglioma-like masses, arrowed; low resolution but plausibly matches key.
Coronal CT shows peripheral wedge-shaped consolidations consistent with septic emboli; neck thrombus not shown but not required by image.
